requiredFindings.title: Bind each accepted source exception to its owning path
requiredFindings.detail: strip_known_test_tail accepts any of the three exact EOF test-module byte strings for every scanned non-outcomes source because neither production_source nor production_feature_sites_are_closed supplies the owning path. A copied accepted tail is therefore removed before cfg(test), attribute, and token checks at an unaccepted file site; KNOWN_CLI_MAIN_SOURCE has the same text-only fast-path issue. Map each tail and the main-source exception to its exact owning path, add cross-path swap/copy controls, and add a compiled path-binding weakening with exact restoration and a fresh positive run. Existing X10/O1/S-OP authority is sufficient; no new design selection is required.
